title: packet-btle: Initial Bluetooth v6.0 support
description:
This merge request adds the initial minimal support for dissecting Bluetooth v6.0 packets.

Bluetooth v6.0 brings a lot of new features. Adding all support at once would result in a way to bit merge request. Therefore, this merge request only adds the initial definitions needed that will help examining packet logs using Bluetooth v6.0 values and packet types. Dissection of the new packets will be added later.

For more information about what is new in Bluetooth v6.0, see https://www.bluetooth.com/blog/now-available-new-version-of-the-bluetooth-core-specification/.

commits_data.title: packet-btle: Dissect v6.0 feature bits (page 0 only)
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Dissect v6.0 feature bits (page 0 only)

Adds dissection of the new feature bits added in Bluetooth
v6.0.
The feature bits for page 1 and beyond are currently not
being populated as the new Feature Page Exchange procedure
PDU contents is currently not being dissected.

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: Add initial dissection of v6.0 control PDUs
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Add initial dissection of v6.0 control PDUs

Adds the definitions of the control PDU types and the expected
flow of the the procedures.
Dissecting the PDU content itself will be done later.
The content of the PDUs itself is more complex.

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: Add inititial dissection of ADV_DECISION_IND
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Add inititial dissection of ADV_DECISION_IND

Adds initial dissection of this new PDU.
The PDU itself is similar to the existing ADV_EXT_IND
with the exception that it contains data.

Some more cleanup is needed in the dissect_btle_adv()
function before it makes sense to parse this new payload.

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>

commits_data.title: packet-btle: Dissect Bluetooth v6.0 version
commits_data.message:
packet-btle: Dissect Bluetooth v6.0 version

Bluetooth v6.0 was recently released. With it comes a new
version number that may be transmitted on air in the
LL_VERSION_IND PDU.

This commit ensures that version number is properly decoded.
The version number is taken from:
https://www.bluetooth.com/specifications/assigned-numbers

Signed-off-by: Rubin Gerritsen <rubin.gerritsen@nordicsemi.no>
